description: This file defines the interface PartitionInterface for AWS SDK's Endpoint namespace. It specifies methods for retrieving partition name, checking region matches, obtaining available endpoints, and being invoked as an endpoint provider.

classes.name: PartitionInterface
classes.description: An interface representing a section of the AWS cloud, providing methods to get partition name, match regions, get available endpoints, and act as an endpoint provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the partition's short name, e.g., 'aws,' 'aws-cn,' or 'aws-us-gov.'

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Determines if this partition contains the provided region, including checking non-regional endpoints for specific services.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns supported endpoints for a given service, with an option to include non-regional endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the partition object to be invoked as an endpoint provider, accepting an array of arguments and returning an array.
